description: The plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model across different epochs, comparing four configurations: small AdaLoRA_int4, small AdaLoRA_int8, small int4, and small int8. The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6 in integer steps, while the y-axis shows the WER, which varies from approximately 25 to 42.5. The small AdaLoRA_int4 (orange dashed line with square markers) starts at a WER of 35.5 and peaks at 42.5 at epoch 2 before declining to 31.5 at epoch 6. The small AdaLoRA_int8 (orange dotted line with circle markers) begins at 30.0, rises to 40.0 at epoch 1, peaks at 42.5 at epoch 2, and then decreases to 31.5 at epoch 6. The small int4 (orange solid line with triangle markers) starts at 30.0, decreases to 27.5 at epoch 3, and then slightly increases to 26.5 at epoch 6. The small int8 (orange dash-dotted line with diamond markers) starts at 30.0, decreases to 25.5 at epoch 5, and then increases to 26.5 at epoch 6. Overall, the WER trends vary significantly across the configurations, with the small AdaLoRA_int4 and small AdaLoRA_int8 showing higher WER values compared to the small int4 and small int8 configurations.
